title: How Quantum Is Bottomonium in the Quark-Gluon Plasma?
summary: We study how much quantum structure bottomonium retains during its evolution in the quark-gluon plasma. Within the open quantum system framework, we simulate the Lindblad equation obtained from potential nonrelativistic QCD in the quantum Brownian regime. From the resulting real-time evolution of the bottomonium density matrix, we compute the Wigner transform and study its negativity as a measure of nonclassicality and a test of a key condition underlying classical Langevin-type approximations. We find that the medium suppresses the negativity, which nevertheless approaches a finite plateau…
